theorems.name: Submission.codim1_hcp_un_hyperplane_projection
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (A₀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (n : Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ A₀ = m + 1 → Module.finrank ℝ Q = m → Q ≤ A₀ → n ∈ A₀ → ‖n‖ = 1 → (∀ v ∈ Q, inner ℝ n v = 0) → ∀ w : Euclid P, Q.starProjection w = A₀.starProjection w - inner ℝ n w • n
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
